The company states that in North America, unit sales of replacement passenger car and light truck tires were in line with the previous year and replacement truck and bus tires were firm, while tires for new vehicles fell below the previous year; in South America, unit sales of passenger car, light truck, and truck and bus tires fell significantly; and revenue in the Americas decreased from the previous year.

entries.726de552db00fbdf: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,429,452 million (¥4.4295 trillion), almost the same level as the previous year. entries.f12403713403c094: With the tire business at its core, the company places at the center of its growth the coexistence of developing attractive products and services with improving cost competitiveness. In addition, it aims to create a circular flow of value by expanding value creation in the Solutions Business and advancing a recycling business that returns tires to raw materials. Using its global production and sales network to build an optimal supply chain, it plans to keep local production for local consumption as the basic principle, while using Japan as a global supply base for tires requiring high technical capability, such as tires for mining vehicles and aircraft. Its vision is to become 'a company that continuously provides social and customer value as a sustainable solutions company by 2050.'
